topics.title: COP31 leaders gather in Turkey
topics.summary: World leaders and delegates are meeting in Antalya for COP31, with discussions centered on turning climate commitments into practical action and maintaining momentum on cleaner energy.
topics.discussionPrompt: Climate summits involve huge promises. What local change would make the idea feel real to you: better transit, cleaner air, lower bills, more trees, or something else?

topics.title: Ukraine peace talks continue in Abu Dhabi
topics.summary: US-led talks involving Ukraine and Russia continued in Abu Dhabi, focusing on a possible path toward ending the war and on longer-term security arrangements.
topics.discussionPrompt: Big negotiations can sound far away. What small sign would make you feel people were genuinely making everyday life safer and more predictable?

topics.title: Rare Scottish wildflowers are moved to safety
topics.summary: Conservationists relocated 3,400 rare one-flowered wintergreen plants from an eroding Scottish coast, hoping to protect the species and strengthen its chances of survival.
topics.discussionPrompt: Saving a tiny wildflower can take a whole team. Is there a plant, bird, or place near you that you would happily volunteer to protect?

topics.title: AI data centers spark power-planning debate
topics.summary: New research says proposed AI data centers may use large on-site gas power stations when grid connections are delayed, raising questions about energy demand and climate goals.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a new data center wanted to move nearby, what would you want settled first: jobs, electricity use, pollution, water, or how it benefits the community?

topics.title: US and China plan AI risk dialogue
topics.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said US and Chinese officials will discuss AI cooperation, competition, testing practices, and a channel for alerting each other to serious incidents.
topics.discussionPrompt: Two rivals trying to cooperate on AI safety is a tricky idea. What is one rule you think everyone building powerful technology should share?

topics.title: Nissan adjusts to China's fast EV shift
topics.summary: Nissan said it will reduce petrol-car production and increase electric and plug-in hybrid output as competition and consumer demand accelerate China's move toward new-energy vehicles.
topics.discussionPrompt: Car trends are changing fast. What would persuade you to switch vehicles someday: price, range, charging convenience, quiet rides, or a feature nobody has invented yet?

topics.title: Flying-car maker eyes China launch
topics.summary: A Chinese manufacturer says its two-seat flying vehicle could begin limited launches next summer, with potential early uses in rural recreation and emergency services.
topics.discussionPrompt: If flying cars became ordinary, would you hop in, watch from the sidewalk, or volunteer to figure out sky traffic rules? What would be your first destination?

topics.title: Global shares rise on renewed AI optimism
topics.summary: Technology stocks helped lift global markets after cloud company CoreWeave reported results that revived investor confidence in AI demand, while questions about debt and valuations remain.
topics.discussionPrompt: When people get excited about a new technology, what keeps the excitement grounded: useful products, careful budgets, independent checks, or simply waiting to see what lasts?

topics.title: UK explores return to EU electricity market
topics.summary: Britain says it is willing to discuss contributions toward EU infrastructure programs as part of talks about rejoining the European electricity market and improving energy trade.
topics.discussionPrompt: Electricity networks are invisible until they matter. Would you rather your region prioritize cheaper power, cleaner power, local control, or stronger connections with neighbors?

topics.title: Old ocean liner gets a reef-sized second act
topics.summary: Plans are advancing to sink the historic SS United States off Florida as an artificial reef, giving the retired ocean liner a proposed new underwater purpose.
topics.discussionPrompt: Turning an old ship into a reef is quite a second act. What retired building, vehicle, or object would you love to see given a creative new purpose?
